meta.name: agent-hierarchy
meta.description: Designs orchestrator-and-subagent hierarchies for a repository — splitting agents by exclusive write surface, pairing every producer with an independent auditor, and enforcing the split with a script that runs in CI. Use this whenever the user wants to set up, expand, audit, or fix a multi-agent or subagent structure for a codebase; asks how to divide work between agents; wants agent charters, roles, or a surface map written; or is hitting agents that collide on the same files, review their own work, or drift from their remit. Also use when sizing a roster or deciding whether a new agent is justified.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划多代理分工并自动校验职责边界
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你在管理代码库中的多个子代理，需要清晰的职责边界与相互审计。
copy.tagline_en: Design multi-agent division of labor with automatic boundary checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple subagents in a codebase and need clear boundaries and mutual audits.

howto.what: Claude 会先查看仓库文件,按文件区域划分代理,每个写代理配一个只读审查代理;产出代理名单、表面地图,并用 CI 脚本检查没有区域冲突。
howto.when: 当你想为代码库搭建或调整多代理/子代理结构,询问如何给代理分工,或遇到代理改同一文件、自审自己工作等问题时触发。

say.text: 给这个仓库设计代理层级:按文件表面划分,配审查代理。
say.note: Claude 会先盘点文件再提出名单和地图。

say.text: 生成 scripts/agent-guard.mjs 并接入 CI。
say.note: 会生成可执行的检查脚本。

say.text: 两个代理都在改 tokens.css,怎么拆开?
say.note: 会按表面拆分并更新地图。

howto.what_en: Claude will inventory the repo's file tree, propose a minimal agent roster partitioned by exclusive write surfaces, pair each writer with a read-only reviewer, and produce a surface map plus a CI guard script.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to set up, expand, audit, or fix a multi-agent structure, asks how to divide work among agents, or faces agents colliding, self-reviewing, or drifting.

say_en.text: Design an agent hierarchy for this repo, split by file surface and add reviewers.
say_en.note: Claude inventories files first, then proposes roster and map.

say_en.text: Generate scripts/agent-guard.mjs and wire it into CI.
Two agents are both editing tokens.css—how do we split them?
say_en.note: Splits by surface and updates the map.
